下载已无损拆分；按清单顺序连接各分块即可还原完整文件。: The download was split losslessly. Concatenate the parts in manifest order to restore the complete file.
通过网址中的 id 打开对应记录；保留报告 assets 和 data 目录即可: The id in the URL selects the record. Keep the report assets and data directories for offline use.
打开 index.html；保留 assets、data 和 figures 目: Open index.html and keep the assets, data, and figures directories for offline use. All records share detail.html; the id in its URL selects the pickle.
全部原始字段、个人参数、后验、迭代日志与复算结果完整保留，数值不取整。数据按字节: All raw fields, individual parameters, posteriors, iteration logs, and audit results are retained in full without rounding. Data are split by byte size. Each CSV part repeats the header, and catalog.json lists every catalog JSON part. Each file is at most 25,000,000 bytes, and the complete reports directory is limited to 10,000 files.
超大浏览器下载会拆成 .part 文件及 .parts.json 清单；按清单顺: Large browser downloads are split into .part files with a .parts.json manifest. Concatenate the binary parts in manifest order to restore the original file losslessly.
所选模型的效用函数 u(z): Utility Functions of Selected Models u(z)
相对参考点的金额 z=x−R（英镑）: Amount Relative to Reference Point z=x−R (£)
效用图以 z=x−R 为横轴，绘图范围为所选金额的正负两侧。z≥0 时 u(z): Utility is plotted against z=x−R over both sides of the selected amount. For z≥0, u(z)=z^α⁺; for z<0, u(z)=−λ(−z)^α⁻. Each curve represents one class.
A(d)=λd^(α⁻−α⁺)，d→0⁺ 时的极限：α⁻>α⁺ 为 0，α⁻=α: A(d)=λd^(α⁻−α⁺). As d→0⁺, the limit is 0 if α⁻>α⁺, λ if α⁻=α⁺, and +∞ if α⁻<α⁺. Curvatures are compared exactly using the estimated values.
选择模型或勾选比较即可查看各类别的效用函数。详情页可调整绘图范围；模型结果另提供: Open a model or select it for comparison to view utility functions for all classes. Adjust the plot range on the detail page; model results also provide SVG/PNG figures with a default range of ±£100. The class overview reports the limit of A(d) as d→0⁺: 0 if α⁻>α⁺, λ if α⁻=α⁺, and +∞ if α⁻<α⁺.
模型、起点、参数与诊断的独立交互报告。所有图表和详情均可离线使用。: A standalone explorer for models, restarts, parameters, and diagnostics. All charts and detail pages work offline.
搜索模型、起点或文件路径: Search Models, Restarts, or File Paths
勾选最多 4 个文件可并排比较。ΔBIC 只以同测试、同协议与同样本的已保存模型: Select up to 4 files to compare side by side. ΔBIC uses saved models with the same test, protocol, and sample as its baseline; ΔLL uses the highest exported LL within the same configuration. Filtering does not change these baselines.
seed 是可复现的随机初始化；corrected 使用修正后结果的参数作为初始: seed is a reproducible random initialization; corrected initializes from corrected results; legacy initializes from old parameters. All three are re-estimated under the current model. Restarts are initializations of the same model and do not increase the number of classes.
LL 越大拟合越好；BIC 越小越好，但比较须使用同样本、同估值协议。k 包含自: Higher LL indicates better fit; lower BIC is preferred, but comparisons require the same sample and valuation protocol. k includes free structural parameters, C−1 mixture shares, and one ξ per participant. BIC does not establish a mechanism or population shares.
converged 只说明 LL 变化达到容差。优化器非成功退出、被拒绝的 M: converged only means that the LL change reached its tolerance. Unsuccessful optimizer exits, rejected M-steps, LL decreases, parameter boundaries, and restart differences require separate checks. Global optimality and gradient convergence are unverified.
检查全域单调性及实际条件彩票的负决策权重。近零 Prelec 属于额外形状警示，: Checks cover global monotonicity and negative decision weights in actual conditional lotteries. Near-zero Prelec is an additional shape warning: even a monotone function may lose almost all intermediate probability information. Complete success requires an audit.
s1/s2/s3 是内部编码，真正的 SQ/PA/LE/FE 权重另行转换。π: s1/s2/s3 are internal encodings; the actual SQ/PA/LE/FE weights are converted separately. π denotes class mixture shares. A(d)=λd^(α⁻−α⁺) compares total magnitudes, while M(d)=A(d)α⁻/α⁺ compares marginal sensitivity.
单类的后验 1 是模型约束；多类高后验也不验证真实类别。ξ 是个人误差比例，σ=: A single-class posterior of 1 is imposed by the model; high multiclass posteriors do not validate true classes. ξ is the individual error scale, with σ=ξ×the original full-lottery spread. Fit diagnostics use all observed CEs for each participant and assess in-sample fit.
标准误、置信区间、参数恢复与样本外验证没有保存在 pickle 中，报告不会据此: Standard errors, confidence intervals, parameter recovery, and out-of-sample validation are absent from the pickles, so the report cannot provide these inferences. Boundary thresholds and the 1% small-class threshold are descriptive warnings only.
只有进度 JSON、尚无完整 pickle 的记录: Progress JSON Records Without a Completed Pickle
独立报告快照。新增结果后重新运行导出脚本即可更新；输入 pickle 不会被修改: Standalone report snapshot. Re-run the exporter after new results are saved to update it. Input pickles remain unchanged.
内部编码：aSQ=s1，aPA=(1−s1)s2，aLE=(1−s1)(1−s2: Internal encoding: aSQ=s1, aPA=(1−s1)s2, aLE=(1−s1)(1−s2)s3, and aFE=1−aSQ−aPA−aLE. Free, fixed, linked, and currently unused parameters are marked separately. Fixed values do not count toward free-parameter boundary warnings.
概率图展示累计概率函数 w(p)，不是各分支直接替代概率。A(d) 与 M(d): The probability plot shows cumulative weighting w(p), rather than direct replacement probabilities for each branch. A(d) and M(d) depend on amount, curvature, and currency units. λ>1 does not ensure greater loss sensitivity at every amount.
LL 与混合份额的迭代记录: Iteration History of LL and Mixture Shares
终值复算改变是最终 LL 减最后一次 E 步记录，不能把它当作最后一轮 EM 的: The final recomputation change is the final LL minus the last recorded E-step LL; it is distinct from the improvement in the last EM iteration. Logs omit the complete θ trajectory, and LL and π within one row may refer to different update times.
共享估值公式复核: Audit Using the Shared Valuation Formula
CE 评价当前未实现支付：筛选路径、归一化条件概率、重新计时，不再扣除已实现支付: CE values current unrealized payments: filter paths, normalize conditional probabilities, and reset the time origin without subtracting realized payments again. Reference points retain the historical nominal benchmarks in the protocol and are compared directly with remaining payments. Residuals are observed−fitted.
多类后验反映模型内部分类；单类后验恒为 1，不能当成分类准确率。下表保留全部参与: Multiclass posteriors reflect classification within the model. Single-class posteriors always equal 1 and cannot measure classification accuracy. The table retains every participant and all class posteriors; pagination only changes the display.
数组与日志完整保留，不截断。dataclass 展开为字段，非有限值以 Infi: Arrays and logs are retained in full. Dataclasses are expanded into fields; nonfinite values are represented as Infinity/NaN strings.
可独立打开本页；保留报告 assets 目录即可使用交互功能。: Open this page independently; keep the report assets directory to use its interactive features.

所选文件属于相同比较组。高后验、低 BIC 与达到 LL 容差均不能证明真实机制: The selected files share a comparison group. High posteriors, low BIC, and reaching the LL tolerance do not establish a true mechanism or global optimality.

打开 index.html；details 和 assets 目录须保留在同一报: Open index.html and keep the details and assets directories in the same report folder. No network connection or server is needed.
总览默认展示模型结果；切换文件类型即可查看所有起点。每个 pickle 有独立详: The dashboard initially shows model results; switch the file type to view all restarts. Every pickle has an independent detail page. Raw fields, parameters, individual ξ values, posteriors, and complete iteration/optimizer logs can be viewed and downloaded.
更新结果快照；运行中的估计不会被停止或修改。默认复算全部 pickle，--a: to update the snapshot; running estimations continue unchanged. All pickles are audited by default. --audit models audits only model results; --audit none reads saved diagnostics only. --models-only exports only model pickles.
ΔBIC 只在相同测试、协议、参与者集合及观测数内比较；等价标签可隐藏。ΔLL: Compare ΔBIC only within the same test, protocol, participant set, and observation count; equivalent labels can be hidden. ΔLL is the gap from the highest exported LL for the same configuration. Single-class posteriors of 1 are imposed by the model. Parameter boundaries, local solutions, and unavailable standard errors limit structural interpretation.
